title: Love to the End
passages: Love to the End (Korean: 끝까지 사랑; RR: Kkeutkkaji sarang) is a 2018 South Korean television series starring Lee Young-ah, Hong Soo-ah, Kang Eun-tak, and Shim Ji-ho. The series aired on KBS2 from Monday to Friday from 7:50 p.m. to 8:30 p.m. (KST) starting July 23, 2018.
